overview_text: Tunisia has a well-structured public hospital system that provides medical imaging and radiology services. Hospitals are categorized into district hospitals, regional hospitals, and university hospitals (CHU). Services range from basic X-rays and ultrasound to advanced CT scans, MRI, PET-CT, and interventional radiology. The public healthcare sector represents more than 80% of hospital beds nationwide. Each governorate has at least one regional hospital equipped with radiology services, while large cities like Tunis, Sousse, Monastir, and Sfax host university hospitals with advanced technologies.
